scope: SpaceFL design evidence, not implementation or deployment
method: Targeted online scholarly-index discovery followed by original PDF reading; not an exhaustive systematic review. PDF pages are one-based file order. No gains estimated from plots.
units_note: Jy = 1e-26 W m^-2 Hz^-1; dB quantities require reference definitions. Values are source-specific, not default engineering constants.
reproducibility_note: PDFs were downloaded to local temporary storage; URLs and SHA256 identify reviewed files. Archive independently before formal replication. Text excerpts are pypdf extraction, not corrected typesetting.
